crossRefs.note: For the thing which I fear comes on me, That which I am afraid of comes to me.
I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; but trouble comes.”
Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.
We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!
Have you utterly rejected Judah? Has your soul loathed Zion? Why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We…
Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful…
For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from Yahweh to the gate of Jerusalem.
The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust…

translations.web: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.
translations.bsb: But when I hoped for good, evil came; when I looked for light, darkness fell.
translations.kjv: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
translations.asv: When I looked for good, then evil came; And when I waited for light, there came darkness.
